PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA=Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CO
OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT_ISSUED.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0; P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false; PRODUCTION HOLD.


1. Scope


Work on the exact current S_B^hard13(delta) positive primitive Stage37 physical source, R<=B.


Retain 229CO:
Pi=(A+Bv)(A+C)(Bv+C),
Omega=ABvC,
S=A+Bv+C=R-2d,
Pi+Omega=2Sd^2,


L_J=gcd(Pi,S)=gcd(Omega,S)=lambda_U lambda_V lambda_z.


Write
L:=L_J^(3')=L_J/3^{v_3(L_J)},
J_sharp=rad(L)=J/gcd(J,3).


Every prime p|J_sharp is coprime to 2d.


Retain the physical color valuation from 229CO/229CG:
for a p in one J color,
v_p(Omega)=2n for the corresponding residual-core valuation n>0.


This card refines the 229CO residual/saturated two-state split. The saturated side itself has three exact p-adic states. One of them is invisible after dividing out the full common gcd and is therefore a necessary new firewall for quotient-support counting.


2. Four-state valuation lemma


Fix p|J_sharp and put


x:=v_p(Pi),
y:=v_p(Omega),
z:=v_p(S),
a:=v_p(L).


Since p does not divide 2d and


Pi+Omega=2Sd^2,                                               (CP.1)


the elementary p-adic sum law gives:


- if x<y, then z=x;
- if y<x, then z=y;
- if x=y, then z>=x.                                         (CP.2)


Because L is the common p-block of gcd(Pi,S) and gcd(Omega,S), (CP.2) implies exactly


a=min(x,y).                                                   (CP.3)


There are therefore exactly four disjoint states:


R — residual / Omega-excess:
x=a<y and z=a.                                                (CP.4R)


P — saturated / Pi-excess:
y=a<x and z=a.                                                (CP.4P)


B — saturated balanced:
x=y=z=a.                                                      (CP.4B)


S — saturated / S-excess:
x=y=a<z.                                                      (CP.4S)


No fifth state is possible.


RESULT_229CP_EVERY_3FREE_J_PRIME_POWER_HAS_EXACTLY_FOUR_COMMON_GCD_VALUATION_STATES=PROVED_EXACT.


3. Physical parity of the saturated states


229CO gives y=2n on every physical J prime.


In state R, a=x<2n and the common block need not have even exponent.


In states P,B,S, a=y=2n is even. Therefore every full prime-power block belonging to P,B,S is a perfect square block.


This identifies 229CO's old split exactly:


L_pair = L_R,
L_outer = L_P L_B L_S,                                      (CP.5)


where the four factors are pairwise coprime and their product is L.


Likewise


J_res=J_R:=rad(L_R),
J_sat=J_P J_B J_S,                                           (CP.6)


with J_P=rad(L_P), J_B=rad(L_B), J_S=rad(L_S).


RESULT_229CP_229CO_RESIDUAL_BLOCK_EQUALS_R_STATE_AND_SATURATED_BLOCK_SPLITS_INTO_THREE_SQUARE_STATES=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Exact unitary and excess routing


Use D||N for unitary divisibility.


State R:
L_R||Pi,
L_R||S,
and every p in J_R has at least one additional p in Omega/L_R.
Hence


L_R J_R | Omega.                                             (CP.7R)


State P:
L_P||Omega,
L_P||S,
Pi has positive excess on every support prime.
Hence


L_P J_P | Pi.                                                (CP.7P)


Since L_P is a square and every exponent in L_P is at least 2,


J_P^3 | Pi.                                                  (CP.8P)


State B:
L_B||Pi,
L_B||Omega,
L_B||S,                                                       (CP.7B)


and L_B is a perfect square.
There is NO forced residual p-factor after removing L_B from any of the three scalars.


State S:
L_S||Pi,
L_S||Omega,
S has positive excess on every support prime.
Hence


L_S J_S | S,                                                 (CP.7S)


and because L_S is a square,


J_S^3 | S < R <= B.                                          (CP.8S)


RESULT_229CP_RESIDUAL_STATE_HAS_OMEGA_EXCESS_LIFT=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CP_PI_EXCESS_SATURATED_STATE_HAS_CUBIC_RADICAL_DIVISIBILITY_IN_PI=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CP_S_EXCESS_SATURATED_STATE_HAS_CUBIC_RADICAL_DIVISIBILITY_IN_S=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CP_BALANCED_STATE_IS_A_COMMON_TRIPLE_UNITARY_SQUARE_BLOCK=PROVED_EXACT.


In particular J_S<=B^(1/3) deterministically.


5. Quotient-support router and the silent channel


Define the exact integer quotients


Pi_0:=Pi/L,
Omega_0:=Omega/L,
S_0:=S/L.


Then


Pi_0+Omega_0=2S_0d^2.                                       (CP.9)


The four-state table becomes


J_R | Omega_0,
gcd(J_R,Pi_0 S_0)=1;                                         (CP.10R)


J_P | Pi_0,
gcd(J_P,Omega_0 S_0)=1;                                      (CP.10P)


J_S | S_0,
gcd(J_S,Pi_0 Omega_0)=1;                                     (CP.10S)


gcd(J_B,Pi_0 Omega_0 S_0)=1.                                 (CP.10B)


Thus the quotient supports see only three of the four J channels.
The balanced square channel J_B disappears completely from support divisibility after the common gcd L has been removed.


RESULT_229CP_THREE_VISIBLE_QUOTIENT_SUPPORT_CHANNELS_PLUS_ONE_SILENT_BALANCED_CHANNEL=PROVED_EXACT.


Critical firewall:
a proof that only controls large common-gcd primes by showing that they must reappear in Pi_0, Omega_0 or S_0 is incomplete. Large J_B is a genuine fourth possibility and carries no quotient-support factor.


6. Combined pair-sum full-square modulus


Retain 229BX/229CA:
Q=q_UV q_Uz q_Vz and Q^2|Pi, with eta=rad(Q).


Retain 229CB:
G is the product of the three full pair gcds,
rad(G)=tau,
gcd(Q,G)=1,
and (QG)^2|Pi.


From 229CC, eta,tau,J are pairwise-coprime support buckets.
Therefore Q,G and the saturated square root


W_sat:=sqrt(L_P L_B L_S)


are pairwise coprime.
Since L_P L_B L_S=W_sat^2 divides Pi,


(Q G W_sat)^2 | Pi.                                         (CP.11)


The residual block L_R is coprime to QGW_sat and also divides Pi. Hence


L_R (Q G W_sat)^2 | Pi.                                     (CP.12)


Using Pi<8B^3/27 gives the deterministic support-height budget


eta^2 tau^2 J_R (J_P J_B J_S)^2
 <= L_R Q^2 G^2 W_sat^2
 <= Pi
 < 8B^3/27.                                                   (CP.13)


RESULT_229CP_ETA_TAU_AND_SATURATED_J_COMBINE_IN_ONE_CHARGED_ONCE_PAIR_SUM_SQUARE_MODULUS=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CP_MIXED_SUPPORT_HEIGHT_BUDGET_eta2_tau2_JR_JSAT2=PROVED_EXACT.


This is one deterministic divisibility on the same scalar Pi. It is not a product of independent sieve probabilities.


7. Quantitative status


No one-third endpoint count is proved.


The new exact structure does dispose one extreme subcase:
J_S>B^(1/3) is impossible because J_S^3|S<B.


But the balanced channel J_B can be arbitrarily large up to the existing square-divisor height ceiling without being visible in the quotient supports.
Therefore the naive strategy
"divide Pi,Omega,S by L and count the three residual quotient supports"
does NOT cover the whole J-large branch.


The current saturated hard core is precisely the large common triple-unitary square block L_B, together with the Pi-excess and S-excess square channels.


Do not:
- assume every J prime reappears in one of Pi_0,Omega_0,S_0;
- assign an independent density to (QGW_sat)^2|Pi;
- multiply CP.12 with the 229CK Omega divisibility as independent gains;
- infer a global count merely from J_P^3|Pi or J_S^3|S;
- revive the closed 229CM ambient m^3 density.


8. Updated theorem interface


The preferred J interface becomes


J_FOUR_STATE_COMMON_GCD_OCCUPANCY:


First retain the stronger 229CO dichotomy
J_sharp=J_R*(J_P J_B J_S).


For the residual R channel, retain 229CN's quotient-level rho lift and CP.10R.


For saturated support, distinguish:
- P: square block with Pi-excess, J_P^3|Pi;
- S: square block with S-excess, J_S^3|S;
- B: square common unitary block L_B||Pi,Omega,S with no quotient-support lift.


The genuinely new hard subproblem is


J_BALANCED_TRIPLE_UNITARY_SQUARE_OCCUPANCY:
count actual hard13 endpoints carrying a large square block L_B that is simultaneously unitary in Pi, Omega and S, while preserving the 229CK colored budget and 229CI dual-radical constraints.


If the balanced block is small, attack the remaining R/P/S excess channels with their corresponding quotient or cubic-divisor structure.


9. Verification


The four-state table is a direct exhaustive valuation analysis of CP.1 for p not dividing 2d.


The perfect-square statements use only the retained physical equality
v_p(Omega)=2v_p(core)
in the saturated case.


CP.11-CP.13 use only already-proved same-scalar divisibilities
(QG)^2|Pi,
L_outer=W_sat^2|Pi,
L_R|Pi,
and the pairwise-coprime support theorem from 229CC.


No physical perfect-cuboid endpoint enumeration is used.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CO — pair-sum/outer-product common-gcd valuation router
STATUS: POST_229CN_SCALAR_VALUATION_COMPRESSION / EXACT_PAIR_SUM_AND_OUTER_PRODUCT_COMMON_GCD / RESIDUAL_UNITARY_PAIR_SUM_BLOCK / SATURATED_SQUARE_UNITARY_OUTER_BLOCK / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN
CARD_DOC_ID=1nT9_1HdxWGZ1IhMFeBolKcQwoLqkiGRvYcO2lZGsiNQ
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA=Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CN
OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT_ISSUED.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0; P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false; PRODUCTION HOLD.


1. Scope


Work on the exact current S_B^hard13(delta) positive primitive Stage37 physical source, R<=B.


Retain the outer gaps
A=R-U, Bv=R-V, C=R-z,
S=A+Bv+C=R-2d,


the pair sums
s=A+Bv, t=A+C, u=Bv+C,


and
Pi:=s t u,
Omega:=A Bv C.


Retain 229CB:
Pi+Omega=2 S d^2.                                             (CO.1)


Retain 229CF:
lambda_U=gcd(A,S)=gcd(A,u),
lambda_V=gcd(Bv,S)=gcd(Bv,t),
lambda_z=gcd(C,S)=gcd(C,s),


the lambda_i are pairwise-coprime odd, and


L_J:=gcd(Omega,S)=lambda_U lambda_V lambda_z.                 (CO.2)


Retain 229CG:
gcd(lambda_U lambda_V lambda_z,d)=1,
and for every p>3 in the U-color J support, p|Y and
v_p(A)=2v_p(Y); cyclically V uses X and z uses E.


Retain 229CN's notation
J_sharp=J/gcd(J,3)
and its residual/saturated support split.


The purpose of this card is to eliminate the twelve-packet bookkeeping from the preferred J interface. The full 3-free J valuation structure can be read directly from the three scalar integers Pi, Omega, S.


2. Exact common-gcd identity


From (CO.1),


Pi == -Omega mod S.


Therefore


gcd(Pi,S)=gcd(Omega,S)=L_J
          =lambda_U lambda_V lambda_z.                        (CO.3)


In particular


J=rad_odd(gcd(Pi,S))
 =rad_odd(gcd(Omega,S)).                                      (CO.4)


RESULT_229CO_PAIR_SUM_AND_OUTER_PRODUCT_HAVE_THE_SAME_FULL_GCD_WITH_S=PROVED_EXACT.


There is also an exact common-product formulation away from 2d.
For any integer N, write N_{perp 2d} for the maximal divisor of N supported on primes not dividing 2d.
Then


gcd(Pi,Omega)_{perp 2d}=L_J.                                 (CO.5)


Proof primewise: let p not divide 2d and put
x=v_p(Pi), y=v_p(Omega).
From Pi+Omega=2Sd^2,
if x!=y then v_p(S)=min(x,y), while if x=y then v_p(S)>=x.
Hence
min(y,v_p(S))=min(x,y).
The left side is the p-adic valuation of gcd(Omega,S)=L_J, and the right side is that of gcd(Pi,Omega).
Conversely every prime of L_J is odd and coprime to d by 229CG.
Thus (CO.5) follows.


RESULT_229CO_J_FULL_GCD_IS_THE_2d_COPRIME_COMMON_PART_OF_PI_AND_OMEGA=PROVED_EXACT.


3. Primewise min-valuation router


Work first in the U color.
Let p>3 divide lambda_U and write


n:=v_p(Y)>0,
w:=v_p(u),
a:=v_p(lambda_U).


Because p|A and p|u, primitivity gcd(A,Bv,C)=1 implies p does not divide Bv or C.
Hence p does not divide s=A+Bv or t=A+C.
Therefore


v_p(Pi)=w,
v_p(Omega)=v_p(A).                                           (CO.6)


The exact square identity
y^2=A(R+U),
together with 229CG exclusions, gives
v_p(y)=n and p does not divide R+U.
Thus


v_p(A)=2n.                                                    (CO.7)


Since lambda_U=gcd(A,u),


a=min(2n,w).                                                  (CO.8)


Also S=A+u.


There are exactly two valuation regimes.


RESIDUAL regime:
w<2n.
Then


a=w,
v_p(Pi)=a,
v_p(S)=a,
v_p(Omega)=2n>a.                                             (CO.9)


SATURATED regime:
w>=2n.
Then


a=2n,
v_p(Omega)=a,
v_p(Pi)>=a,
v_p(S)>=a,                                                    (CO.10)


and a is even.


The V and z colors are cyclically identical.


RESULT_229CO_EVERY_3FREE_J_PRIME_POWER_IS_ROUTED_BY_MINIMUM_OF_PI_AND_OMEGA_VALUATIONS=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Scalar residual and saturated full blocks


Write


L_J^(3'):=L_J / 3^{v_3(L_J)}.


Define two coprime full prime-power blocks by


L_pair :=
 product over p>3 with v_p(Pi)<v_p(Omega)
 of p^{v_p(L_J)},


L_outer :=
 product over p>3 with v_p(Omega)<=v_p(Pi)
 of p^{v_p(L_J)}.                                             (CO.11)


Then


L_J^(3')=L_pair L_outer,
gcd(L_pair,L_outer)=1.                                       (CO.12)


Use D || N to denote unitary divisibility:
D|N and gcd(D,N/D)=1.


By (CO.9),


L_pair || Pi,
L_pair || S.                                                  (CO.13)


By (CO.10),


L_outer || Omega,
L_outer | S.                                                  (CO.14)


Moreover every prime exponent in L_outer is a=2n, hence even. Therefore


L_outer=W_outer^2                                            (CO.15)


for an integer W_outer.
The same valuation calculation shows colorwise
sqrt(saturated U block)|Y,
sqrt(saturated V block)|X,
sqrt(saturated z block)|E.
Since the color supports are pairwise coprime,


W_outer | E X Y.                                              (CO.16)


RESULT_229CO_RESIDUAL_BLOCK_IS_COMMON_UNITARY_DIVISOR_OF_PI_AND_S=PROVED_EXACT.

- L_outer || Omega, L_outer=W_outer^2, L_outer|S, W_outer|EXY;

This is a strictly smaller theorem interface than the twelve signed packet system:

229CN's quotient-level rho lift remains valid as a secondary refinement on the L_pair branch.
Its support is exactly rad(L_pair).


7. Quantitative firewall


No one-third endpoint count is proved here.


The fixed-radical B^o(1) fibers of Pi and Omega do not by themselves count endpoints with a LARGE common radical divisor.
A large radical of a receiver is not a low-support event.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CN — first-order matched-lattice collapse and residual-overlap quotient lift
STATUS: POST_229CM_FIRST_ORDER_DEPENDENCE_AUDIT / MATCHED_m_CUBED_DENSITY_COLLAPSE_ON_PHYSICAL_SQUARE_LOCUS / RESIDUAL_OVERLAP_RHO_QUOTIENT_LIFT / SATURATED_SUPPORT_SQUARE_DIVIDES_S / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN

1. Scope


Work on the exact current S_B^hard13(delta) positive primitive Stage37 physical source, R<=B.


Retain 229CM. For one U-color linear packet
m=mu_{U,alpha,beta}, alpha,beta in {+1,-1}, epsilon=alpha beta,
let
L=2n1-alpha ga-beta d0c,
Xopp=z-V,
and let sigma be the 229CG root modulo m^2 inherited from lambda_U^2:
sigma^2 == -2 mod m^2,
Xopp == 2 sigma d mod m^2.


Retain
e=bga, x=bd0c, U=bn1,
A=R-U,
u=Bv+C=2R-V-z,
S=A+Bv+C=R-2d.
Hence exactly
u=U-2d.                                                     (CN.1)


Retain 229CM:
m|L,
m|Y^2,
and packet signs (alpha,beta) are exactly the simultaneous physical signs for the p-adic U-color channel.


This card audits whether the extra factor m in the ambient m^3 matched lattice is genuinely new on the physical square locus. It is not at first order. The surviving new input is a higher-order overlap modulus rho defined below.


2. First-order primitive-leg line is algebraically dependent on the outer root line


Because m|lambda_U,
m|A and m|u.
Using (CN.1),


R == U == 2d mod m.                                         (CN.2)


Also
V+z=2R-u == 2U mod m,                                      (CN.3)
while
Xopp=z-V == 2 sigma d == sigma U mod m.                     (CN.4)


The exact face-square identities give


e^2=(U^2+V^2-z^2)/2,
x^2=(U^2+z^2-V^2)/2.                                       (CN.5)


From (CN.3)-(CN.4),


e^2 == U^2(1-2sigma)/2 mod m,
x^2 == U^2(1+2sigma)/2 mod m.                               (CN.6)


All primes of m are >3 and 229CG exclusions give gcd(mxU, m)=1 in the required denominators; in particular 2,3,x,U and 1+2sigma are units modulo m.
Since sigma^2==-2,


(1-2sigma)(1+2sigma)=1-4sigma^2 == 9 mod m.                 (CN.7)


Therefore


(e/x)^2
 == (1-2sigma)/(1+2sigma)
 == ((1-2sigma)/3)^2 mod m.                                 (CN.8)


But 229CM's primitive-leg line is, after multiplying r=ga,s=d0c by the p-unit b,


3 epsilon e == (1-2sigma)x mod m.                            (CN.9)


Thus (CN.9) is exactly one square-root choice of the already-forced identity (CN.8). For each odd prime power there are at most two such square-root choices; over composite m the total branch count is at most 2^omega(m)=B^o(1).


Cyclically the same statement holds for the V-color pair (e,y) and z-color pair (x,y).


RESULT_229CN_FIRST_ORDER_PRIMITIVE_LEG_CONGRUENCE_IS_SQUARE_ROOT_SELECTION_ON_PHYSICAL_LOCUS=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CN_AMBIENT_m_CUBED_LATTICE_EXTRA_m_IS_NOT_AN_INDEPENDENT_FIXED_POWER_DENSITY=PROVED_ALGEBRAIC_FIREWALL.


Interpretation:
the ambient block lattice in 229CM still has exact index m^3 as a lattice in independent coordinates. But after imposing the Stage37 physical square identities, its additional mod-m primitive-leg equation contributes only a square-root/sign selection of an identity already forced by the outer root line. Therefore the factor m may not be charged as a new endpoint-density saving.


3. Canonical residual-overlap decomposition


Keep one packet m and its residual core Ccore:
Ccore=Y for U,
Ccore=X for V,
Ccore=E for z.


Set


q:=gcd(m,Ccore).                                             (CN.10)


Because 229CM gives m|Ccore^2,


m | q^2.                                                     (CN.11)


Define


rho:=q^2/m,
s:=m/q.                                                      (CN.12)


Then s|q and


q=rho s,
m=rho s^2.                                                   (CN.13)


In particular rho is a positive integer divisor of m.


For a prime p^a||m, write n=v_p(Ccore). Then a<=2n and


v_p(q)=min(a,n),
v_p(rho)=2min(a,n)-a,
v_p(s)=max(a-n,0).                                           (CN.14)


Thus rho measures the non-saturated overlap between the full lambda valuation and the residual-core square.


RESULT_229CN_PACKET_CANONICAL_DECOMPOSITION_m_EQUALS_rho_TIMES_s_SQUARED=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Higher-order quotient lift survives


We prove the U-color statement; the other two colors are cyclic.


Let p^a||m and n=v_p(Y).
From 229CG exclusions and 229CM sign identification,
p does not divide the complementary unit factors, so the exact square factorizations give


v_p(A)=2n,
v_p(V-alpha e)=2n,
v_p(z-beta x)=2n.                                           (CN.15)


Therefore q^2=m rho divides all three quantities:


m rho | A,
m rho | V-alpha e,
m rho | z-beta x.                                           (CN.16)


Since


u-bL
 =2(R-U)-(V-alpha e)-(z-beta x)
 =2A-(V-alpha e)-(z-beta x),                                (CN.17)


we obtain


m rho | u-bL.                                                (CN.18)


Because m|u and m|L,


rho | u/m - b(L/m).                                         (CN.19)


This is a genuine quotient-level congruence. It disappears exactly when rho=1.


Likewise, from
Xopp=z-V,
(CN.16) gives


m rho | Xopp-(beta x-alpha e).                              (CN.20)


The 229CG root line gives
m^2 | Xopp-2sigma d.
Since rho|m, m rho|m^2, hence


m rho | beta x-alpha e-2sigma d.                            (CN.21)


Finally m|L and m|u=U-2d imply


m | alpha e+beta x-4d.                                      (CN.22)


Thus the first-order edge congruences of 229CM sharpen to the mixed-modulus physical-edge system


alpha e+beta x == 4d mod m,
beta x-alpha e == 2sigma d mod m rho.                       (CN.23)


Cyclically:


V color, core X:
alpha e+beta y == 4d mod m,
beta y-alpha e == 2sigma_V d mod m rho.                     (CN.24)


z color, core E:
alpha x+beta y == 4d mod m,
beta y-alpha x == 2sigma_z d mod m rho.                     (CN.25)


RESULT_229CN_NON_SATURATED_PACKET_HAS_QUOTIENT_LEVEL_RHO_LIFT=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CN_EDGE_DIFFERENCE_ROOT_LINE_LIFTS_FROM_m_TO_m_rho_ON_PHYSICAL_EDGES=PROVED_EXACT.


This rho-lift, not the first-order ambient m^3 determinant, is the remaining potentially chargeable matched-incidence input.


5. Residual-support versus fully saturated-support split


Across all twelve pairwise-coprime 229CM packets m_j, define rho_j by (CN.10)-(CN.13).


Let


J_sharp=J/gcd(J,3)=rad(product_j m_j),
J_res:=rad(product_j rho_j),
J_sat:=J_sharp/J_res.                                       (CN.26)


The supports of J_res and J_sat are disjoint.


By (CN.14),
v_p(rho_j)=0 if and only if a=2n.                            (CN.27)


Therefore a prime is in J_sat exactly when its packet valuation fully saturates the corresponding residual-core square valuation.


For such a saturated prime,
a=2n>=2,
so p^2 divides m_j.
Consequently


J_sat^2 | product_j m_j
        = lambda_U^(3') lambda_V^(3') lambda_z^(3').         (CN.28)


The three lambda_i are pairwise coprime and each divides S. Hence


lambda_U^(3') lambda_V^(3') lambda_z^(3') | S,
so


J_sat^2 | S=R-2d < R <= B.                                  (CN.29)


RESULT_229CN_FULLY_SATURATED_J_SUPPORT_SQUARE_DIVIDES_S=PROVED_EXACT.


On a J-large branch J>K,
J_sharp>K/3.
Since J_sharp=J_res J_sat,


max(J_res,J_sat) > sqrt(K/3).                                (CN.30)


Thus every J-large endpoint lies in one of two exact subbranches:


(A) RESIDUAL-OVERLAP:
J_res>sqrt(K/3), carrying the quotient-level rho lift (CN.19)-(CN.25);


(B) FULL-SATURATION:
J_sat>sqrt(K/3), with the large square divisor J_sat^2|S<R.


RESULT_229CN_J_LARGE_SPLITS_INTO_LARGE_RHO_SUPPORT_OR_LARGE_SQUARE_DIVISOR_OF_S=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Quantitative firewall


No one-third endpoint count is proved here.


Do not:
- charge the 229CM ambient m^3 determinant as a physical endpoint density;
- multiply the first-order outer and primitive-leg congruences as independent events;
- infer a saving merely from m=rho s^2;
- infer a saturated-branch endpoint count merely from J_sat^2|S without a fixed-S or selector-aware square-divisor theorem.


The first-order matched-lattice route is now closed as an independent fixed-power mechanism.
The only genuinely sharper J inputs retained from 229CM are:
- packet linearization/sign channels;
- the higher-order rho quotient lift when rho>1;
- the fully saturated square-divisor alternative J_sat^2|S.


7. Updated J theorem interface


Replace the previous preferred contract
J_TWELVE_LINEAR_PACKET_SAME_ROOT_MATCHED_INCIDENCE
by

Residual branch:
count actual hard13 endpoints with large J_res using the same-physical congruences
rho | u/m-scale*(L/m)
and

8. Verification

so it vanishes modulo m whenever sigma^2==-2 mod m.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CM — physical conic factorization and same-root matched linear packets
STATUS: POST_229CL_PHYSICAL_CONIC_LINEARIZATION / FOUR_LINEAR_FACTORS_PER_COLOR / TWELVE_SIGNED_PACKETS / SAME_ROOT_MATCHED_MODULUS_LATTICE / NORM_FORM_INDEPENDENCE_FIREWALL / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN
CARD_DOC_ID=1F7dp5W7VcbcI8R_hGHR2n262CFPOGhi0QmDJR_xDKX8
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA=Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CL
OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT_ISSUED.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0; P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false; PRODUCTION HOLD.


1. Scope


Work on the exact current S_B^hard13(delta) positive primitive Stage37 physical source, R<=B.


Retain 229CL:
for the three colors i=U,V,z,
lambda_i^(3') is captured by a residual-core square and one of two primitive discriminant -32 forms
N_i^±=3r_i^2±2r_i s_i+3s_i^2,
with
(r_U,s_U,n_U)=(ga,d0 c,n1), U=b n1,
(r_V,s_V,n_V)=(gb,d0 f,n2), V=a n2,
(r_z,s_z,n_z)=(bc,af,q), z=d0 q,
and
r_i^2+s_i^2=n_i^2.


Retain 229CG:
for each lambda_i there is a root sigma_i modulo lambda_i^2 with sigma_i^2==-2 and the corresponding opposite-gap root line
X_i == 2 sigma_i d mod lambda_i^2,
where
X_U=Bv-C=z-V,
X_V=A-C=z-U,
X_z=A-Bv=V-U.


This card proves that the apparently quadratic 229CL norm packets split exactly into four physical linear packets on the retained Pythagorean conic, and that each packet is tied to the same sigma_i appearing in the 229CG square-modulus root line.


2. Exact physical conic factorization


Let r,s,n be positive coprime integers with r^2+s^2=n^2.
For alpha,beta in {+1,-1}, define
L_{alpha,beta}(r,s,n):=2n-alpha r-beta s.                      (CM.1)


Since r+s<2n, all four L_{alpha,beta} are positive.


Directly,
(2n-r-s)(2n+r+s)
 =4n^2-(r+s)^2
 =3r^2-2rs+3s^2,                                              (CM.2)


and
(2n-r+s)(2n+r-s)
 =4n^2-(r-s)^2
 =3r^2+2rs+3s^2.                                              (CM.3)


Thus on the actual physical Pythagorean conic,


N_i^- = L_{+,+}^{(i)} L_{-,-}^{(i)},
N_i^+ = L_{+,-}^{(i)} L_{-,+}^{(i)},                          (CM.4)


with
L_{alpha,beta}^{(U)}=2n1-alpha ga-beta d0c,
L_{alpha,beta}^{(V)}=2n2-alpha gb-beta d0f,
L_{alpha,beta}^{(z)}=2q-alpha bc-beta af.                     (CM.5)


RESULT_229CM_DISCRIMINANT_MINUS32_NORM_FORMS_FACTOR_INTO_FOUR_PHYSICAL_LINEAR_PACKETS=PROVED_EXACT.


This is a physical-source factorization. It is not a factorization of the binary quadratic form over Z[r,s] without adjoining the physical hypotenuse n; it uses the retained selector equation n^2=r^2+s^2.


3. Coprimality of the four linear packets away from 6


Fix one primitive triple (r,s,n).


Within one conjugate pair, suppose an odd prime p divides both
2n-alpha r-beta s
and
2n+alpha r+beta s.
Then p|n and p|(alpha r+beta s).
Using n^2=r^2+s^2 gives
0 == r^2+s^2 == 2r^2 mod p
after substituting r==-alpha beta s.
For odd p this forces p|r,s, contradicting gcd(r,s)=1.
Hence each conjugate pair has no common odd prime.


For a cross-pair common prime p>3, p would divide both N^- and N^+.
229CL proved that gcd(N^-,N^+) has no prime divisor >3.
Therefore every prime p>3 divides at most one of the four L_{alpha,beta}.  (CM.6)


RESULT_229CM_FOUR_LINEAR_PACKETS_PAIRWISE_COPRIME_OUTSIDE_6=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Twelve full-valuation lambda packets


For each color i and each (alpha,beta), allocate every prime power p^a||lambda_i^(3') to the unique L_{alpha,beta}^{(i)} divisible by p^a.
Define the resulting packet mu_{i,alpha,beta}.


Then exactly


lambda_i^(3') = product_{alpha,beta} mu_{i,alpha,beta},        (CM.7)


the four packets for a fixed color are pairwise coprime, and because lambda_U,lambda_V,lambda_z are pairwise coprime, all twelve packets over the three colors are pairwise coprime.


Combining with 229CK/229CL core-square capture gives


mu_{U,alpha,beta} | gcd(Y^2,L_{alpha,beta}^{(U)}),
mu_{V,alpha,beta} | gcd(X^2,L_{alpha,beta}^{(V)}),
mu_{z,alpha,beta} | gcd(E^2,L_{alpha,beta}^{(z)}).            (CM.8)


RESULT_229CM_FULL_3FREE_LAMBDA_VALUATIONS_REFINE_TO_TWELVE_PAIRWISE_COPRIME_LINEAR_PACKETS=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CM_LINEAR_PACKET_CORE_SQUARE_INTERSECTION=PROVED_EXACT.


This strictly sharpens the six quadratic packets of 229CL.


5. Physical sign meaning of one packet


We prove the U-color statement; V and z are cyclic.


Let p^a||mu_{U,alpha,beta}, and put n=v_p(Y).
229CG exclusions give p>3 and
p does not divide a,b,c,d0,g,c12.
Hence v_p(y)=n.


From
V^2-e^2=y^2
and p not dividing e, exactly one sign alpha_0 satisfies
v_p(V-alpha_0 e)=2n.


From
q^2-(bc)^2=(af)^2
and p not dividing abc, exactly one sign beta_0 satisfies
v_p(q-beta_0 bc)=2n.
Since z=d0q and x=d0bc,
v_p(z-beta_0 x)=2n.


Also p^a|lambda_U gives p^a|(R-U) and p^a|(2R-V-z).
Because a<=2n,


2U-alpha_0 e-beta_0 x
 = (2R-V-z)-2(R-U)+(V-alpha_0 e)+(z-beta_0 x)
is divisible by p^a.


Dividing by the p-unit b shows
p^a | L_{alpha_0,beta_0}^{(U)}.
By the uniqueness in Section 3,
(alpha_0,beta_0)=(alpha,beta).                                  (CM.9)


Thus the four packet labels are not artificial: they are exactly the two simultaneous Pythagorean sign choices seen by the same physical prime power.


RESULT_229CM_LINEAR_PACKET_LABEL_EQUALS_SIMULTANEOUS_PHYSICAL_SIGN_CHANNEL=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Same-root compatibility with the 229CG square-modulus line


Again take p^a||mu_{U,alpha,beta}.
Let epsilon=alpha beta.


Because p^a|lambda_U and S=R-2d,
2d == R == U mod p^a.                                         (CM.10)


The 229CG root line gives
z-V == 2 sigma_U d mod p^a,
hence by Section 5
beta x-alpha e == sigma_U U mod p^a.                           (CM.11)


The packet relation gives
2U == alpha e+beta x mod p^a.                                  (CM.12)


Set t=e/x=(ga)/(d0c) modulo p^a.
All denominators are p-units.
From (CM.11)-(CM.12),


sigma_U
 == 2(beta-alpha t)/(alpha t+beta)
 == 2(1-epsilon t)/(1+epsilon t).                              (CM.13)


Squaring (CM.12) and using U^2=e^2+x^2 gives


3t^2-2epsilon t+3 == 0 mod p^a.                               (CM.14)


Using (CM.14) in (CM.13),


2 sigma_U == 1-3epsilon t mod p^a.                             (CM.15)


Equivalently,


3 epsilon (ga) == (1-2 sigma_U)(d0c) mod p^a.                 (CM.16)


The cyclic identities are


3 epsilon (gb) == (1-2 sigma_V)(d0f) mod p^a,                 (CM.17)


3 epsilon (bc) == (1-2 sigma_z)(af) mod p^a.                  (CM.18)


Because sigma_i^2==-2, a prime p>3 cannot divide 1-2sigma_i:
otherwise 2sigma_i==1 would give -8==1 and p|9.
Hence the matched linear congruence is nondegenerate on every packet.


CRT therefore upgrades (CM.16)-(CM.18) from individual prime powers to each whole packet m=mu_{i,alpha,beta}.


RESULT_229CM_SAME_SQRT_MINUS2_ROOT_CONTROLS_OUTER_DIFFERENCE_AND_PRIMITIVE_LEG_RATIO=PROVED_EXACT.


7. Matched modulus lattice


For one packet
m=mu_{i,alpha,beta},
epsilon=alpha beta,
let (r_i,s_i) be its primitive leg pair and X_i its 229CG opposite-gap difference.


The same physical endpoint lies in the block lattice


X_i == 2 sigma_i d mod m^2,
3 epsilon r_i == (1-2 sigma_i)s_i mod m.                       (CM.19)


The first congruence has index m^2 in the (X_i,d) block.
The second has index m in the (r_i,s_i) block because 3epsilon is invertible modulo m.
Therefore the product lattice in Z^4 has exact index


[Z^4:Lambda_{i,m,alpha,beta,sigma_i}] = m^3.                  (CM.20)


The admissible sigma_i choices remain only 2^omega(m)=B^o(1).


RESULT_229CM_PACKET_MATCHED_SAME_ROOT_LATTICE_HAS_EXACT_INDEX_M_CUBED=PROVED.


Important firewall:
the m^3 lattice index is NOT assigned as an endpoint density.
The two coordinate blocks come from the same physical endpoint, and 229CG already reconstructs endpoints from the outer-gap block up to B^o(1).
Multiplying an m^-2 outer packing factor by an m^-1 primitive-leg factor without a same-physical incidence theorem would double-charge deterministic structure.

229CM shows that on the exact physical source those norm forms are already reducible through the retained Pythagorean hypotenuse.


Therefore the preferred J theorem interface is sharpened from

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CL — discriminant-minus-32 norm packets for full lambda valuations
STATUS: POST_229CK_NESTED_CROSS_SELECTOR_DELTA / DISCRIMINANT_MINUS_32_NORM_PACKET / FULL_3FREE_LAMBDA_VALUATION_SIGN_SPLIT / CORE_SQUARE_INTERSECT_PRIMITIVE_NORM_FORM / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN

OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT_ISSUED.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0; P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false; PRODUCTION HOLD.


1. Scope


Work on the exact current S_B^hard13(delta) positive primitive Stage37 physical source, R<=B.


Retain 229CK:
A=R-U, Bv=R-V, C=R-z, S=A+Bv+C,
lambda_U=gcd(A,S)=gcd(A,Bv+C),
lambda_V=gcd(Bv,S)=gcd(Bv,A+C),
lambda_z=gcd(C,S)=gcd(C,A+Bv),
with lambda_U,lambda_V,lambda_z pairwise-coprime odd;
for 3-free parts,
lambda_U^(3')|Y^2, lambda_V^(3')|X^2, lambda_z^(3')|E^2.


Retain 229CG:
for every p>3 in rad(lambda_U), p|Y and p does not divide R;
cyclically rad(lambda_V) maps to X and rad(lambda_z) maps to E.
Retain 229BN:
e=gab, x=d0bc, y=d0af,
E=g/h, X=c/c21, Y=f/c12,
and the primitive gcd relations listed there.


The purpose of this card is to add a second, genuinely cross-selector capture of the full 3-free lambda valuations: each prime power is forced into one of two primitive positive-definite binary norm packets of discriminant -32 built from the complementary two edges.


2. Exact U-color norm identity


Put
u=Bv+C=2R-V-z.


Define
Phi_U^-:=3e^2-2ex+3x^2,
Phi_U^+:=3e^2+2ex+3x^2.


Using
R^2=e^2+x^2+y^2,
V^2=e^2+y^2,
z^2=x^2+y^2,
U^2=e^2+x^2,
we have


u(2R+V+z)
 =4R^2-(V+z)^2
 =3e^2+3x^2+2y^2-2Vz.


Multiplying by the conjugate factor gives the exact identity


u(2R+V+z)(3e^2+3x^2+2y^2+2Vz)
 = Phi_U^- Phi_U^+ + 8y^2 U^2.                 (CL.1)


Now let p^a || lambda_U^(3') so p>3.
Because lambda_U|u and lambda_U|A, p^a|u and p^a|A.
229CG gives p does not divide R, hence p does not divide R+U because U==R mod p.
From
y^2=A(R+U)
we therefore have p^a|y^2.
Equation (CL.1) then yields


p^a | Phi_U^- Phi_U^+.                           (CL.2)


For such p, 229CG+229BN give p|Y and p does not divide h,a,b,d0,c; in particular p does not divide e x.
Since
Phi_U^+ - Phi_U^- = 4ex,
p cannot divide both Phi_U^- and Phi_U^+.
Therefore the entire p^a contribution goes into exactly one sign packet.


RESULT_229CL_U_COLOR_FULL_3FREE_LAMBDA_VALUATION_SPLITS_UNIQUELY_INTO_TWO_NORM_PACKETS=PROVED_EXACT.


3. Primitive discriminant -32 forms


Factor out the physical common edge-content:


e=b(ga), x=b(d0c).


Define
N_U^-:=3(ga)^2-2(ga)(d0c)+3(d0c)^2,
N_U^+:=3(ga)^2+2(ga)(d0c)+3(d0c)^2.


229BN gives gcd(ga,d0c)=1. Since every p>3 in lambda_U is coprime to b, the sign packet divisibility from Section 2 descends from Phi_U^±=b^2 N_U^± to N_U^± itself.


Cyclically define


N_V^-:=3(gb)^2-2(gb)(d0f)+3(d0f)^2,
N_V^+:=3(gb)^2+2(gb)(d0f)+3(d0f)^2,


with gcd(gb,d0f)=1, and


N_z^-:=3(bc)^2-2(bc)(af)+3(af)^2,
N_z^+:=3(bc)^2+2(bc)(af)+3(af)^2,


with gcd(bc,af)=1.


For any coprime positive integers r,s,


3r^2-2rs+3s^2=(r+s)^2+2(r-s)^2,
3r^2+2rs+3s^2=(r-s)^2+2(r+s)^2.               (CL.3)


Thus all six N_i^± are primitive positive-definite binary quadratic forms of discriminant -32, and each is an integral Q(sqrt(-2)) norm after the displayed determinant-2 linear substitution.


Moreover
N_i^+ - N_i^- =4rs,
N_i^+ + N_i^- =6(r^2+s^2).
If a prime p>3 divided both N_i^+,N_i^-, then p|rs and p|(r^2+s^2), contradicting gcd(r,s)=1.
Therefore


gcd(N_i^+,N_i^-)
has no prime factor >3.                                  (CL.4)


This makes the sign allocation canonical for every 3-free lambda prime power.


RESULT_229CL_THREE_PRIMITIVE_DISCRIMINANT_MINUS32_NORM_PAIRS=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CL_SIGN_PACKETS_ARE_COPRIME_OUTSIDE_6=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Six full-valuation packets and core-square intersection


There are unique coprime factorizations


lambda_U^(3') = ell_U^- ell_U^+,
lambda_V^(3') = ell_V^- ell_V^+,
lambda_z^(3') = ell_z^- ell_z^+,


such that


ell_U^± | N_U^±,
ell_V^± | N_V^±,
ell_z^± | N_z^±.                                  (CL.5)


Because the three lambda_i are pairwise coprime and each sign pair is coprime, the six ell_i^± are pairwise coprime.


Combining (CL.5) with 229CK full-valuation core capture gives the exact same-physical cross-selector divisibilities


ell_U^± | gcd(Y^2,N_U^±),
ell_V^± | gcd(X^2,N_V^±),
ell_z^± | gcd(E^2,N_z^±).                         (CL.6)


Equivalently, every p>3 contribution to the J/lambda branch is simultaneously visible
(1) in one residual core square Y^2, X^2, or E^2, and
(2) in one of two primitive discriminant -32 norm forms built from the complementary physical parameters.


This is strictly more structured than the statement lambda_i^(3')|core_i^2 alone and is absent from the 229CJ macro-only joint-pair host.


RESULT_229CL_FULL_LAMBDA_VALUATIONS_CAPTURED_BY_CORE_SQUARE_INTERSECT_PRIMITIVE_NORM_PACKET=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CL_SIX_PAIRWISE_COPRIME_SIGNED_LAMBDA_PACKETS=PROVED_EXACT.


5. Relation to the -2 root lines


The norm forms in (CL.3) explain the same local splitting field already seen in the 229CG congruences sigma_i^2==-2 mod lambda_i^2.


This card does not charge the norm-packet condition as a new independent local density on top of the 229CG square-modulus root lines. Both are deterministic projections of the same physical endpoint. The new information is the global cross-selector placement: the full 3-free prime-power packet must occur simultaneously in a residual core square and in a primitive norm-form value in complementary parameters.


6. Current theorem interface


Define the new J sub-interface


J_CORE_NORM_PACKET_CORRELATION:
on the exact hard13 source, retain simultaneously
- the dual radical pair and kappa=rad(G0)>T;
- J>K and the 229CK colored square-gap budget;
- the 229CG lambda_i^2 opposite-difference root lines;
- the 229CK full valuation capture lambda_U^(3')|Y^2, lambda_V^(3')|X^2, lambda_z^(3')|E^2;
- the six canonical signed packets ell_i^± from (CL.5)-(CL.6).


A useful counting theorem may now target a large common-divisor/correlation event
gcd(core_i^2,N_i^±)
on three primitive norm-form channels rather than treating lambda support as free entropy over a fixed dual radical pair.


CURRENT_PREFERRED_J_INTERFACE=
COLORED_SQUARE_GAP_BUDGET + DUAL_RADICAL_PAIR + LAMBDA_SQUARE_MODULUS_ROOT_LINES + CORE_SQUARE_INTERSECT_DISCRIMINANT_MINUS32_NORM_PACKETS.


7. Quantitative firewall


No one-third endpoint count is proved here.


Do not:
- multiply the six signed packet conditions as independent sieve events;
- treat Q(sqrt(-2)) split-prime support by itself as a saving;
- infer a fixed-power gain from the fact that each N_i^± is a positive-definite norm form;
- forget the one-way 229CK fact that fixed dual radical pair -> only B^o lambda tuples, while the reverse fiber remains uncontrolled.


The correct possible gain must come from same-physical occupancy of the common-divisor events in (CL.6), from the exact R-height/selectors, or from collapse of many dual radical pairs onto few realized norm/core packet configurations.


If no such gain is found, the existing eta/tau/M_i/K_cross fallback remains unchanged.

The norm representations (CL.3) are exact expansions.
A finite arithmetic sanity check over 10,000 random coprime pairs (r,s) found no prime >3 in gcd(N^+,N^-), matching the direct proof (CL.4).

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229CK — nested colored square-gap budget and full-valuation lambda capture
STATUS: POST_229CJ_NESTED_PHYSICAL_DELTA / COLORED_SQUARE_GAP_BUDGET / FULL_VALUATION_LAMBDA_CAPTURE / FIXED_DUAL_PAIR_SUBPOWER_LAMBDA_BRANCHING / LAMBDA_SUPPORT_ENTROPY_FIREWALL / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN

1. Scope and notation


Work on the exact current S_B^hard13(delta) physical source with all positive primitive Stage37 selectors and R<=B.


Retain
A=R-U, Bv=R-V, C=R-z,
S=A+Bv+C,
Omega=ABvC,
lambda_U=gcd(A,S),
lambda_V=gcd(Bv,S),
lambda_z=gcd(C,S),
and
r_U=rad(lambda_U),
r_V=rad(lambda_V),
r_z=rad(lambda_z),
J=r_U r_V r_z.


Retain 229CG:
lambda_i^2 exact -2 root lines on the opposite-gap differences,
r_U^2|A, r_V^2|Bv, r_z^2|C,
and for p>3 the J colors inject
r_U^#|Y, r_V^#|X, r_z^#|E,
where
r_i^#=r_i/gcd(r_i,3),
E=g/h_edge,
X=c/c21,
Y=f/c12,
h_edge=gcd(e,R)=gcd(g,q).


Retain 229CI:
Sigma_xy=rad(xy),
Sigma_R=rad(eR),
kappa=rad(G0)=gcd(Sigma_xy,Sigma_R),
Sigma_xy=kappa A_xy,
Sigma_R=kappa A_R,
with kappa,A_xy,A_R pairwise-coprime squarefree.
On J>K, J_sharp=J/gcd(J,3) divides A_xy A_R.


This card extracts two genuinely nested physical constraints that are absent from the 229CJ macro-only host.


2. Physical content divisors of the three outer gaps


Retain the exact nested content system:
c12=gcd(U,y), c21=gcd(V,x), h_edge=gcd(e,z).


Because
U^2+y^2=R^2,
V^2+x^2=R^2,
z^2+e^2=R^2,
we have
c12|R,
c21|R,
h_edge|R.
Hence
c12|R-U=A,
c21|R-V=Bv,
h_edge|R-z=C.                                             (CK.1)


229AD gives that h_edge,c12,c21 are pairwise coprime and every odd prime divisor of each is 1 mod4.


229CG gives
r_U^2|A,
r_V^2|Bv,
r_z^2|C.                                                   (CK.2)


For the U color, every p>3 dividing r_U is excluded from c12 by 229CG, while p=3 cannot divide c12 because every odd prime of c12 is 1 mod4.
Thus
gcd(r_U,c12)=1.
Cyclically,
gcd(r_V,c21)=1,
gcd(r_z,h_edge)=1.                                         (CK.3)


Combining (CK.1)-(CK.3):
c12 r_U^2 | A,
c21 r_V^2 | Bv,
h_edge r_z^2 | C.                                          (CK.4)


RESULT_229CK_COLORED_CONTENT_TIMES_J_SQUARE_DIVIDES_EACH_OUTER_GAP=PROVED_EXACT.


3. Nested colored square-gap budget


All quantities in (CK.4) are positive. Since
A+Bv+C=S<R,
we obtain the exact same-physical additive budget
c12 r_U^2 + c21 r_V^2 + h_edge r_z^2 < R <= B.             (CK.5)


This condition is not visible in the 229CJ ambient macro product triple.


Multiplying (CK.4),
h_edge c12 c21 J^2 | Omega=ABvC.                            (CK.6)


Equivalently,
h_edge c12 c21 J^2
 <= Omega
 <= (S/3)^3
 < R^3/27.                                                  (CK.7)


Thus
J < R^(3/2) / sqrt(27 h_edge c12 c21).                       (CK.8)


RESULT_229CK_NESTED_COLORED_SQUARE_GAP_ADDITIVE_BUDGET=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229CK_WEIGHTED_J_SQUARE_DIVIDES_OMEGA=PROVED_EXACT.


These are structural constraints only; no endpoint power saving follows from (CK.5) or (CK.7) by themselves.


4. Full-valuation capture of the lambda moduli by residual cores


For an integer n define its 3-free part
n^(3') := n / 3^v3(n).


We prove
lambda_U^(3') | Y^2,
lambda_V^(3') | X^2,
lambda_z^(3') | E^2.                                       (CK.9)


Take p>3 with p^a||lambda_U.
Then p|A, so U==R mod p.
229CG proves p does not divide R.
Hence
R+U==2R mod p
is a p-adic unit.


The exact face identity
y^2=A(R+U)
therefore gives
v_p(A)=2v_p(y).                                             (CK.10)


229CG's p>3 color localization puts p in Y and excludes p from d0,a,c12.
Since
y=d0 a c12 Y,
we have
v_p(y)=v_p(Y).                                              (CK.11)


As lambda_U|A,
a=v_p(lambda_U)<=v_p(A)=2v_p(Y).                            (CK.12)


Thus the full p-adic contribution of lambda_U divides Y^2.
Taking all p>3 proves the first divisibility in (CK.9).


The V and z colors are identical:
Bv(R+V)=x^2, x=d0 b c21 X,
C(R+z)=e^2, e=h_edge E a b,
together with the 229CG exclusions, give the remaining two divisibilities.


RESULT_229CK_LAMBDA_3FREE_FULL_VALUATIONS_CAPTURED_BY_RESIDUAL_CORE_SQUARES=PROVED_EXACT.


This is strictly stronger than the 229CG radical-only statements
r_U^#|Y, r_V^#|X, r_z^#|E.


5. Consequence for the dual radical pair


The support of lambda_U^(3') and lambda_V^(3') is contained in the xy-side residual radical A_xy.
The support of lambda_z^(3') is contained in the eR-side residual radical A_R.


Fix one realized pair
(Sigma_xy,Sigma_R).
Then kappa,A_xy,A_R are fixed.


For lambda_U^(3'), its radical is some divisor of A_xy and lambda_U^(3')<B.
There are B^o(1) possible radical divisors of A_xy.
For each fixed radical support, the retained 229BQ prescribed-prime-support lemma gives B^o(1) possible full integers of polynomial height.
Therefore there are B^o(1) possible lambda_U^(3') values.
